name: copy-paste-pad
title: Copy Paste Pad
description: A 3-D aluminium macro pad whose ⌘C and ⌘V copy and paste the theme.
docs:
Copy Paste Pad — A 3-D aluminium macro pad whose ⌘C and ⌘V copy and paste the theme.

The stylesheet sits next to the component and is imported by it, so keep the two together in components/pinui/.

It is drawn in Inter (400 and 500) for the overlays, with Varela Round for the keycap legends (Arial Rounded where it is missing). If your project does not already load that face it will fall back to your system sans and look noticeably different.

It comes in two themes: pass theme="dark" for the dark one, or wire the prop to your own theme switch.

It renders with three.js's WebGPU renderer (three 0.186 or newer — earlier WebGPU builds can leave a keycap on stale lighting after the theme changes), falling back to WebGL 2 on its own, and imports three when it mounts. Pass onThemeChange so ⌘V can change your theme. ⌘C and ⌘V are only taken while the pad is hovered or focused.
